config.criterion: previous FM burst criterion, all physical static traces; no new acceptance relaxation
config.selection: physical, all six training peak counts and eight static regimes; then DOP853 training loss
config.continuation_reason: first pass retained extra training peak at tau80 and barely moved mixing; before any heldout readout, shared eligible prior control seed plus matched 3D global search
